question: What is the callsign of the fastest flight in the dataset?
sparql:
SELECT ?callsign WHERE {
  ?flight a <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#Flight> .
  ?flight <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#hasFlightEvent> ?event .
  ?event <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#gspeed> ?speed .
  FILTER(?speed = (SELECT MAX(?s) WHERE { ?f a <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#Flight>; ?f <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#hasFlightEvent> ?e; ?e <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#gspeed> ?s } ) .
  ?flight <http://www.semanticweb.org/ontologies/flight_ontology#hasCallsign> ?callsign .
} LIMIT 1
